inlines.v: BLINK, verb intransitive 1. To wink; to twinkle with the eye. 2. To see obscurely. Johnson. Is it not to see with the eyes half shut, or with frequent winking, as a person with weak eyes? One eye was blinking and one leg was lame. BLINK, noun A glimpse or glance. BLINK, noun blink of ice, is the dazzling whiteness about the horizon, occasioned by the reflection of light from fields of ice at sea.
